info.title: ets
info.description: Command-line tool (ets) for inspecting, converting, and debugging Easy.TimeSeries files.

commands.name: convert-to-parquet
commands.description: Convert time-series file to Apache Parquet format.

options.name: --input-path
options.description: Path to the time series file. [Required]

options.name: --output-path
options.description: Output file path; if not provided, the output will be generated next to the input file. [Default: null]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing output file and create the output directory if missing.

commands.name: ref-files-parquet
commands.description: Generate reference Apache Parquet files into a directory.

options.name: --dir-path
options.description: Target directory for the generated files. [Required]

commands.name: ref-files-ts
commands.description: Generate reference Easy.TimeSeries (.ts) files into a directory.

options.name: --dir-path
options.description: Target directory for the generated files. [Required]
